title: Purple Mage Fighter
description: A young female warrior with white hair in an elaborate updo stands in a dynamic pose against a solid dark gray background. She wears a white and purple traditional outfit with armor-like plates, a flowing sash, and sandals, while casting glowing purple magical energy from both hands with crescent moon and circular symbols.
prompt: A fierce young East Asian female warrior with long flowing white hair in an ornate bun and purple ribbons, wearing a detailed white and purple traditional fantasy outfit with armored plates, wide sleeves, and a flowing sash. She stands in a powerful combat stance casting glowing purple arcane energy from both hands, one forming a crescent moon symbol and the other a swirling orb. Purple magical particles and a glowing halo effect surround her head, solid dark gray background, clean digital painting style
